name: sdlc
title_zh: 卡在意图到代码之间时，它告诉你下一步该交哪份文档
tagline_zh: 你说「可以开始写代码了吗」，它先翻你的仓库看意图、规格、计划、ADR 齐没齐，缺哪份就让你补哪份，不齐不放行。
tagline_en: Ask "can I start coding?" and it checks your repo for intent, spec, plan, and ADRs — then blocks you until the.
desc_en: Determine and produce the next artifact in the intent → spec → plan → code chain for a project under ~/dev, and enforce the gates between them. Use when the user asks what the next step is, what to work on next, whether they can start coding, or asks to write or review a spec, plan, ADR, or intent document.
why_zh: 它把文档链当成有闸门的流水线，每份产物只在下游依赖它时才被要求写，不搞一次性大而全的模板。
why_en: Treats docs as a gated pipeline: each artifact is only demanded when something downstream needs it, not as one big upfront.
limit_zh: 只认 ~/dev 下的项目，别处的仓库它不扫；只管意图→规格→计划→代码这条链，测试、部署、发布不在它视野里。
limit_en: Only scans projects under ~/dev. Covers just the intent→spec→plan→code chain — no testing, deploy, or release. Gates are advisory; it can't stop you.
title_en: Tells you which document to write next, intent to code
